name: English
shop_alice_encounter:
* Welcome to Master [name:hong]'s Grocery.
[wait:5]* How can I help you?
shop_alice_main: * Thanks for visiting my little old place.
shop_alice_sell_dialogue_1:
[emote:idle]* Huh?
[wait:5]You have something to sell me?
shop_alice_sell_dialogue_2:
[emote:left]* Sorry, but here's no scrapyard.
[wait:5]* I'm trying to make a living by stuff-selling,
not junk-buying.
shop_alice_about_1:
[emote:idle]* Me?[wait:5] My name's [name:hong_alice],
[wait:5]the gatekeeper at
Scarlet Devil Mansion.
shop_alice_about_2:
[emote:left]* At least I was one.
[wait:5]* Now I'm just a nameless youkai running a small shop.
shop_alice_mansion_1:
[emote:idle]* The Scarlet Devil Mansion, the residence of Lady [name:remilia_scarlet].
[wait:5]* It's also where I used to work.
shop_alice_mansion_2:
[emote:idle]* Now it has become a heavily fortified castle,
[wait:5]whose danger level has gone up by about 70% higher than before.
shop_alice_mansion_3:
[emote:idle]* As the former gatekeeper,
[wait:5]I feel deeply sorry about that.
[wait:5]* After all, you'll never see those fairies playing at the Mansion's gate again.
shop_alice_bandage_1:
[emote:left]* Are you talking about the bandages wrapped around my head?
[wait:5]* Those were pierced through by Lady [name:remilia_scarlet] herself.
shop_alice_bandage_2: [emote:idle]* If I weren't so resilient, I'd have been dead for good.
shop_alice_bandage_3: [emote:idle]* But even so, I won't hate Lady [name:remilia] anyway.
shop_alice_why_1:
[emote:left]* To say there's none at all would be a lie. But I know Lady Remilia wasn't always like that.
[wait:5]* And this is certainly not her fault.
shop_alice_why_2:
[emote:left]* A while ago, [wait:5]something unusual suddenly occurred inside the Mansion...
[wait:10]* A dark fountain appeared.
shop_alice_why_3: * Lady Patchouli was drawn to it and decided to keep it for study.
shop_alice_why_4:
* But as time went on, [wait:5]everyone in the Mansion started acting strangely.
[wait:5]* Even I, who usually live outside, was somewhat affected.
shop_alice_why_5: * Just as I was heading to the grand library to ask Lady Patchouli to stop her research and explain the effects, Lady Remilia stopped me.
shop_alice_why_6:
* After an argument, [wait:5]she summoned Gungnir and pierced my head right through...
[wait:10][emote:idle]* Sorry, I got a bit off track, didn't I?
shop_alice_why_7:
* Anyway, [wait:5]Lady Remilia isn't bad by nature.
[wait:5]* She only became this way because of the influence of that so-called dark fountain.
shop_alice_legendary_1:
[emote:happy]* So that rumor is true, huh?
[wait:5]* You guys do seem to have some heroic streak.
shop_alice_legendary_2: [emote:idle]* Sorry, but the only help I can offer is to sell you some stuff that could be useful.
shop_alice_legendary_3:
* And I can't give you a discount either.
[wait:5]* I've got to make a living myself, you know?
